preserve_aspect_ratio.description:
If set to true, the aspect ratio of the generated image will be preserved even
        if the image size is too large. However, if the image is not a multiple of 32
        in width or height, it will be resized to the nearest multiple of 32. By default,
        this snapping to the nearest multiple of 32 will not preserve the aspect ratio.
        Set crop_output to True, to crop the output to the proper aspect ratio
        after generating.

num_images.description: The number of images to generate.

expand_prompt.description: If set to true, the prompt will be expanded with additional prompts.

loras.description: The list of LoRA weights to use.

force.description: If set to true, the embedding will be forced to be used.

path.description: URL or path to a LoRA safetensors file. Or HF model name that resolves to safetensors weights.

scale.description:
The scale of the LoRA weight. This is used to scale the LoRA weight
            before merging it with the base model.

sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.

seed.description:
The same seed and the same prompt given to the same version of Stable Diffusion
            will output the same image every time.

height.description: The height of the generated image.

width.description: The width of the generated image.

image_size.description: The size of the generated image.

format.description: The format of the generated image.

crop_output.description: If set to true, the output cropped to the proper aspect ratio after generating.

embeddings.description: The list of embeddings to use.

path.description: URL or the path to the embedding weights.

tokens.description:
The list of tokens to use for the embedding. When omitted, tokens
            are generated as <s0>, <s1>, ... to match the number of vectors in
            the embedding file.

image_url.description: The URL of the image to use as a starting point for the generation.

negative_prompt.description:
The negative prompt to use.Use it to address details that you don't want
            in the image. This could be colors, objects, scenery and even the small details
            (e.g. moustache, blurry, low resolution).
examples: cartoon, illustration, animation. face. male, female

guidance_scale.description:
The CFG (Classifier Free Guidance) scale is a measure of how close you want
            the model to stick to your prompt when looking for a related image to show you.

prompt.description: The prompt to use for generating the image. Be as descriptive as possible for best results.
examples: an island near sea, with seagulls, moon shining over the sea, light house, boats int he background, fish flying over the sea

strength.description: determines how much the generated image resembles the initial image

num_inference_steps.description: The number of inference steps to perform.

enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled.

request_id.description:
An id bound to a request, can be used with response to identify the request
            itself.

safety_checker_version.description: The version of the safety checker to use. v1 is the default CompVis safety checker. v2 uses a custom ViT model.
